messages.text:
BL-1094 — The dispatch-gap auto-route cites HEAD as its commit, and the BL-953 coherence gate then refuses it because HEAD's subject names a different ticket - so the daemon's third duty has succeeded once in 29 attempts, and that once was a coincidence
What it solves: Found 2026-08-23 while investigating a coder note about misroutes. The note reported "4 misroutes: active tickets keep mint status:todo assigned_to:coder forever"; running the sweep showed the four `assigned_to: coder` actives all HAVE dispatch trails and are correctly left alone, and that the real…
Approval context: Firm: the auto-route must be able to succeed. Today it structurally cannot, except by coincidence.
Your call is WHICH of two correct-looking fixes, and they are not equivalent:
(a) Exempt the daemon's own generated auto-route from the BL-953 coherence gate. The gate exists to catch a human reusing …
BL-1094 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1094" (or "reject BL-1094 <reason>") to act.
